subject: ENGLISH 9
pageTitle: Comma Splices and FANBOYS: When to Use a Comma
description: Fix comma splices with FANBOYS, a semicolon or a period, and know when a comma is not needed, with two worked examples.
caption: Comma splices fixed in 7 swipes: FANBOYS, semicolons and two worked examples. Free English 9 study guide at precisstudy.com/english-9 (no sign-up).

slides.title: COMMA SPLICES: STOP JOINING SENTENCES WITH A COMMA.
FANBOYS
slides.note: Put a comma before a FANBOYS word when it joins two full sentences.

slides.title: THREE WAYS TO FIX A SPLICE
slides.note: A comma alone cannot join two full sentences.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: Fix: I studied all night, I still felt nervous.
steps: Both sides are full sentences joined by only a comma.
Add a FANBOYS word after the comma.
slides.answer: I studied all night, but I still felt nervous.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: Fix: She likes tea, and coffee.
steps: Coffee is not a full sentence.
A plain list of two items needs no comma.

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: I like soccer, I play every day
points: That is a comma splice: two sentences, one comma.
Add and after the comma, or swap the comma for a semicolon.
